name: USAspending.gov API
agency: U.S. Department of the Treasury (Bureau of the Fiscal Service)

endpoints.description: Search federal awards (contracts, grants, loans) by filters

limits.notes: No key, no published hard quota. Many endpoints are POST with JSON filter bodies. Heavy queries can be slow; paginate with page/limit.

llmDocs.summary: Every federal award: contracts, grants, loans, direct payments — by recipient, agency, location, NAICS, time period. The authoritative federal spending dataset.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Most search endpoints are POST with a filters object: time_period, award_type_codes (A/B/C/D = contracts, 02-05 = grants, etc.), agencies, recipient_search_text, place_of_performance_locations. Specify fields[] for columns. Paginate with page and limit.
gotchas: award_type_codes are required for spending_by_award and determine contract vs grant; mixing incompatible fields errors.
Fiscal year runs Oct 1 - Sep 30; time_period filters use calendar dates.
Recipient identifiers transitioned from DUNS to UEI; older docs reference DUNS paths.
